title: Moss Stitch Granny Square
author: Kimberly Arenas
notes: start: original Round 1 opens 'Ch x2, in the 2nd ch from the hook:' (all Round 1 stitches worked into one chain, i.e. a ring start); replaced by 'Make a magic ring.' and Round 1 kept as worked into that centre. Turned after every round (sc/ch moss stitch worked in the round). 'Round 3 and onwards' normalised to 'Round 3:'; the round lines joined. Page says repeat Round 3 to the desired size.
